cases.text: At the beginning of each of your upkeeps for the rest of the game, remove all mire counters from a land that a mire counter was put onto with CARDNAME but that a mire counter has not been removed from with CARDNAME.

At the beginning of each of your upkeeps for the rest of the game, remove all flood counters from an artifact that a flood counter was put onto with it but that a flood counter has not been removed from with it.

At the beginning of each of your upkeeps for the rest of the game, remove all charge counters from a creature that a charge counter was put onto with this artifact but that a charge counter has not been removed from with this artifact.
